pick.name: Langfuse
pick.what: Open-source LLM tracing, prompt management, evals, datasets (OTel-based SDKs)
pick.why: Most adopted OSS option, strong TS SDK (@langfuse/tracing 6.0.2), generous free cloud, self-host for regulated data
pick.free_limits: Hobby: 50k units/mo, 30-day retention, 2 users, 30 req/min API. Core $29/mo (100k units, 90 days). HIPAA/BAA only on Pro ($199/mo) and Enterprise; HIPAA US region Enterprise only; 50% startup discount year 1
pick.maintained: langfuse py 5.0.4 on 2026-10-21; @langfuse/tracing 6.0.2 on 2026-10-22; acquired by ClickHouse 2026-01-16, MIT core retained

best_free.name: Opik (Comet)
best_free.what: Apache-2.0 tracing + evals + pytest integration, Python and TS SDKs
best_free.why: Fully Apache-2.0 tracing and evals with free self-hosting; Langfuse (MIT) is also free to self-host
best_free.free_limits: Self-hosted open source: free, unlimited spans and retention. Comet-hosted Free: 25k spans/month, 60-day retention, up to 10 team members. HIPAA not stated.

alts.name: Arize Phoenix
alts.what: OTel/OpenInference tracing, evals, datasets, prompt mgmt; pip or single container
alts.why: Lightest self-host, MCP endpoint for Claude Code, strong Python coverage
alts.free_limits: Self-host free; telemetry on by default (PHOENIX_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false)
alts.license: Elastic-2.0 (not OSI open source; cannot offer as managed service)

alts.name: OpenLIT
alts.what: OpenTelemetry-based tracing, evals and guardrails for AI agents
alts.maintained: release date not shown on repo page (opened 2026-10-28)
alts.install: pip install openlit  |  npm install openlit

candidates.name: Langfuse
candidates.verdict: Pick: biggest community, MIT, strong TS

candidates.name: Helicone
candidates.verdict: Reportedly acquired by Mintlify March 2026, maintenance mode (secondary sources); avoid

decision: Langfuse Cloud Hobby for dev; for any regulated data or enterprise client self-host it (MIT) because Hobby/Core exclude HIPAA. Move to Phoenix if the ClickHouse stack is too heavy for solo ops, or Opik if you need strictly OSI licences.
details: Retained; ClickHouse acquisition flagged (MIT retained). Supported self-hosted Enterprise reportedly bundled with ClickHouse commercial plans (secondary source). OpenInference: https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference

verify.note: Hobby 50k units/30 days/2 users, Core $29 (100k units), Pro $199 with BAA, 50% first-year startup discount: confirmed.
